meta.name: mass-ulw
meta.description: Drives dependency-ordered child work through the native workflow tool, one run per phase with retry/amend/send recovery. Use when the user asks for mass-ulw, a DAG of tasks, or fan-out work where some tasks must wait on others.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 调度一批互相依赖的子任务,按阶段依次执行,失败自动重试补救
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果要让一大批有先后依赖的任务分成多个子任务按序跑完
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you must fan out many interdependent tasks across child workers in order

howto.what: 把有先后依赖的任务整理成任务图：依赖就绪的节点并行成波执行；单个节点失败可单独重试、发消息纠偏或修订定义，已完成节点的结果会缓存复用。运行以结果验证通过为结束，而不是最后一个节点上报完成。
howto.when: 当你要求 mass-ulw、需要一张任务 DAG，或某些任务必须等其它任务先完成时分发执行时触发。每次运行只覆盖一个阶段的依赖泳道，下一阶段要新开一次运行。

say.text: 用 mass-ulw 把这批任务排成 DAG 跑起来
say.note: 会先读规划文档再定义任务图

say.text: 重试这次运行里失败的 lint 节点，并把它的提示改成跳过 vendor 目录
say.note: 只有该节点重新执行，已完成节点复用

say.text: 给正在跑的 build 节点发消息，让它别改 src 之外的目录
say.note: 按范围边界就地纠偏该子任务

howto.what_en: Runs dependency-ordered child work as a graph: nodes run in parallel waves as dependencies clear; one bad node can be retried, messaged, or amended without rerunning finished nodes. A run ends only when result verification passes.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for mass-ulw, a task DAG, or fan-out work where some tasks must wait on others. One run covers only a single phase's dependency-ordered lanes.

say_en.text: Use mass-ulw to turn this batch of tasks into a DAG and run it
Retry the failed lint node and change its prompt to skip vendored dirs
say_en.note: Only that node re-runs; finished nodes are reused

say_en.text: Send a message to the running build node: don't touch anything outside src
